content:
Hi, I’m telixirx, a sophomore majoring in Computer Science and Technology at Zhejiang University, with a minor in ACEE (Advanced Honor Class of Engineering Education) , Chu Kochen Honors College. I mainly split my time between Hangzhou and Shanghai.
I usually go by telixirx or tlxtianlanxu online. Feel free to contact me everywhere.
This site is mainly for my tech posts and shared experiences — such as blogs, notes, essays, etc. QZone remains my primary outlet for yapping and random thoughts.
Contact GitHub: @telixirx Website: https://telixirx.github.io/ Email: tlxtianlanxu@163.com tlxtianlanxu@gmail.com tlxtianlanxu@edu.zju.cn …… My QQ account is easiee to find. Come say hi o(｀ω´ )o Education Middle School: HFLS (Hangzhou Foreign Languages School) 2019.9 – 2022.7
Those old days… ( ; _ ; )/~~
High School: HFLS (Hangzhou Foreign Languages School, again) 2022.9 – 2025.7
Regeneron ISEF 2024 Finalist won First-Class Scholarship twice CS honor student in the Talent Program Went off to DTLA at 17. Best Trip OF ALL TIME! ✈️ Undergraduate: Zhejiang University 2025.9 – Present
Major: Electronic Information Engineering (EE actually) ➡️ Computer Science and Technology Minor: ACEE (Advanced Honor Class of Engineering Education) Currently Learning ~~~ CTF / Cybersecurity Logic and Computer Design / Computer Organization — Verilog / FPGA CSAPP Games101 / Computer Graphics Embedded Systems Why no achievements or projects here? Because I suck (:/). Nothing feels worth showing off yet, so I'm moving forward to the next level. I promise I'll fill them in ASAP. QAQ
Misc. Used to be an OIer. Retired for being mediocre. Still love algorithms and data structures tho.
Huge Touhou Project fan since 2019. If you’re into Touhou MMD, music, games, fiction, anime, or literary / fan creations, come find me at 浊浪文工团 if you need a deep conversation. Though I’ve been pretty busy lately :0
I really like Harumaki Gohan (はるまきごはん), who inspires me every now and then. Heww, almost craving lol. Note
The following has nothing to do with my résumé. Just for fun (´･ω･`)
Interests Mathematics The purest and most elegant subject. Reading My reading lists are stored in my QZone. Tell me if I have good taste <3. It generally only involves books I’ve read since I became mentally mature; (Well, according to my own definition of MATURE <3) hardcore technical references are not included in my list (currently). Sports Two-time 1500m champion during high school. I usually run the 400m, 800m, and 1500m. Around 48 minutes for a 10 km run on campus, sub-5:00/km pace. Hiker. Often travel alone and tend to get lost. Quite risky tho. TBH, I’m not particularly good at anything. I just hope I can survive a little longer when the apocalypse comes… Languages In terms of languages I’m familiar with (e.g. English, German, Japanese), I can easily tell whether someone is a native. Shout out to HFLS for educating me for 6 years.
English I get brain rot sometimes, that’s why I assume I talk like a native speaker. Well, clearly, I don’t. CET-4/CET-6: 647/653, with an A score in the oral test. My vernacular is basically a mashup of various celebrities and streamers, leaning American. My speaking is pretty chat-like, and I’m at home with a diabolical amount of American pop culture and Gen Z slang, only because I’ve been living on YouTube and Twitch for years. No cap. Goblin Hundreds of hours of xQc. Former MCYT stan, also with 100+ hours watched. Fairly experienced at deciphering all kinds of cursive accents, with Mr. Cow being my specialty. Deutsch Studied in class from 14 to 16; passed A1 at 15. Haven’t studied it for a long time sadge. I suppose my pronunciation is decent. I can follow standard German, but Austrian and Swiss accents always puzzle me. Japanese Purely interest-driven. Vocabulary far ahead of grammar. Currently reading haiku and trying to read Japanese originals, including classics, light novels, manga, etc. Spanish Self-studying. Know the basics solamente. Games Streaming In the know of top YouTubers and Twitch streamers, as well as Twitch culture, chat emotes, and the whole gaming industry. I like catching up with mainstream games and indie games, across almost every genre. Rhythm Games osu! mania: 1756 pp total / 109 pp max My peak was probably around 3.3–3.5★ S-rank level, with a fairly consistent 75–82 pp and high acc on slower maps. Temporarily retired. Galgame Played parts of Summer Pockets. 紙の上の魔法使い all endings.
